description: Place a signed DCA (dollar-cost-average) order on Epsilon: total_amount_in of token_in is sold for token_out in equal chunks, one every interval_seconds, executions times. One signature covers the whole schedule. Requires a prior approve_token covering total_amount_in.

confirm.description: set true to confirm placement (only required when the server runs with EPSILON_REQUIRE_CONFIRM=1)

slippage_bps.description: max fill slippage in basis points

total_amount_in.description: TOTAL amount of token_in across all executions, human units

name: place_dca_order
